_source: AHG program structure from AHGFamily, not handbook prose — committable. The Faith Award is AHGFamily's "B.Y. Faith Award": one award per level (a different colored pin each), each a single "complete one of the following studies" list. The handbooks don't print it; AHGFamily's list is the only source, so it is built from the catalog's short titles (scripts/build-badges.js, catalog-only). Lists differ a little by level (Patriots add Live It Out; retired studies vary) — always read the level's own award.
_faithBadges: Handbook badges tagged as faith badges, by catalog name (every current level variant). Until a badge's handbook annotation exists in data/handbook/, it is built from AHGFamily's short titles so it can be planned and tracked now; the annotation replaces the text later under the same ids.
_links: Faith Award study title (as AHGFamily lists it) → the faith badge that satisfies it. Earning the badge at a level completes that level's Faith Award item. Studies not listed here (patch programs, outside studies) are planned and recorded on the Faith Award item itself — AHGFamily keeps those patch programs as whole-award-only, with no requirements to track.
